default.$description: Page background. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.

primary.$description: Solid fill for the main action color. Pairs with foreground.primary.

inverse.$description: Surface that is dark in Light mode and light in Dark mode (tooltips, inverted blocks). Pairs with foreground.inverse.

danger.$description: Solid fill for destructive actions and errors. Pairs with foreground.danger.

raised.$description: Surface of a component that floats above the page (card, popover, dropdown, dialog, sheet, toast). The same as the page in Light, one step lighter in Dark.

overlay.$description: Scrim color behind a modal or sheet. The dialog, alert dialog and sheet apply it at 90% through their overlay-opacity tokens, so it is never opaque.

muted.$description: Quiet surface for sections, panels and containers. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.

emphasis.$description: Stronger surface for nested or emphasized areas, one step more contrast than muted. The default and muted foreground tokens are readable on it.

intense.$description: Strongest surface step, one more than emphasis. Components use it for pressed fills on neutral surfaces; the default and muted foreground tokens are readable on it.

primary-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the primary role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.primary-muted.

primary-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid primary fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.primary is readable on it.

primary-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid primary fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.primary is readable on it.

secondary.$description: Solid fill of the secondary action (the Secondary button and badge). Pairs with foreground.secondary.

secondary-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid secondary fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.secondary is readable on it.

secondary-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid secondary fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.secondary is readable on it.

danger-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the danger role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.danger-muted.

danger-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid danger fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.danger is readable on it.

danger-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid danger fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.danger is readable on it.

success.$description: Solid fill for positive confirmation. Pairs with foreground.success.

success-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the success role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.success-muted.

success-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid success fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.success is readable on it.

success-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid success fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.success is readable on it.

warning.$description: Solid fill for caution. Pairs with foreground.warning.

warning-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the warning role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.warning-muted.

warning-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid warning fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.warning is readable on it.

warning-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid warning fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.warning is readable on it.

info-muted.$description: Quiet informational tint for alerts and highlights. Pairs with foreground.info-muted.

info.$description: Solid fill for informational messages (the info toast, info badge). Pairs with foreground.info.

info-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid info fill. Components use it for hover states; foreground.info is readable on it.

info-intense.$description: Strongest tone of the solid info fill, one step beyond emphasis in the direction hover moves. Components use it for pressed states; foreground.info is readable on it.

accent.$description: Fill of selected and on-state controls (checked checkbox, radio and switch, slider range, progress, selected tab and page). Pairs with foreground.accent; non-text, so it needs 3:1 on the page.

primary.$description: Accent border in the primary color (cards, highlights, rings); non-text, so it needs 3:1 on the page.

success.$description: Border in the success color for alerts, toasts and highlights.

warning.$description: Border in the warning color for alerts, toasts and highlights.

danger.$description: Border in the danger color for alerts, toasts and highlights.

info.$description: Border in the info color for alerts and highlights; non-text, so it needs 3:1 on the page.

default.$description: Default border for cards, inputs and containers.

emphasis.$description: Stronger border for control boundaries that need 3:1 against the page (inputs, checkboxes, switches).

default.$description: Default text and icon color for headings and body content. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.

muted.$description: Quieter text for descriptions and captions. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.

faint.$description: Faintest text for timestamps, metadata and hints. Readable on the page, muted and raised backgrounds.

link.$description: Text color for links on the page, raised and muted surfaces; needs 4.5:1 on each. Underline inline links.

primary.$description: Text and icons on the solid primary fill. Pairs with background.primary and background.primary-emphasis.

primary-muted.$description: Primary text on its tint (background.primary-muted) and on the page.

danger.$description: Text and icons on the solid danger fill. Pairs with background.danger and background.danger-emphasis.

danger-muted.$description: Danger text on its tint (background.danger-muted) and on the page.

success.$description: Text and icons on the solid success fill. Pairs with background.success and background.success-emphasis.

success-muted.$description: Success text on its tint (background.success-muted) and on the page.

warning.$description: Dark text and icons on the solid warning fill (an amber fill cannot hold light text). Pairs with background.warning and background.warning-emphasis.

warning-muted.$description: Warning text on its tint (background.warning-muted) and on the page.

info-muted.$description: Informational text on its tint (background.info-muted) and on the page.

info.$description: Text over the solid info fill. Readable on background.info and its emphasis and intense tones.

secondary.$description: Text over the solid secondary fill. Readable on background.secondary and its emphasis and intense tones.

accent.$description: Mark or text over the accent fill (check, dot, selected number). Readable on background.accent.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator: the 2px outline. Foreground tone, so it reaches at least 3:1 against the halo and the page in both modes. Centralized: every component's focus indicator uses it.

halo.$description: Keyboard focus halo: the page-tone band drawn between the control and the outline and outside the outline, so the indicator is separated from any fill or surface it sits on.

base.$description: Default shadow for cards and raised elements

md.$description: Medium shadow for dropdowns and popovers

lg.$description: Large shadow for modals and overlays

xl.$description: Extra large shadow for maximum elevation

loop.$description: One turn of a looping indicator such as a spinner

loop-slow.$description: One cycle of a slow ambient loop such as a loading skeleton's pulse

linear.$description: Constant speed, for loops that should not accelerate

default.$description: How far a surface travels while it enters or leaves

enter.$description: Scale a surface starts from while it enters, and ends at while it leaves

hover.$description: Scale a card or tile grows to on hover

hover-strong.$description: Scale an icon grows to on hover, a stronger emphasis than a card or tile

lg.$description: Display Large — hero H1 at largest breakpoint (60px)

md.$description: Display Medium — hero H1 at medium breakpoint (48px)

sm.$description: Display Small — hero H1 base or section H2 large (36px)

lg.$description: Heading Large — section H2 base breakpoint (30px)

md.$description: Heading Medium — subheadings and prominent labels (24px)

sm.$description: Heading Small — card titles and feature item headings (20px)

offset.$description: Gap between the control and the focus outline, filled with the halo color.

halo-width.$description: Width of the halo band outside the focus outline.

local.$description: Stacking above siblings inside one component, below every shared layer

modal.$description: Modal dialogs, sheets, and similar blocking overlays

popover.$description: Popovers, hover cards, and floating panels

tooltip.$description: Tooltips — highest priority for transient hints
